title: The Fool says, There Is No God

questions.question: The fool says in his heart, "There is no what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:1 (ESV): "The fool says in his heart, 'There is no God.'"

questions.question: They are corrupt, they do abominable deeds; there is none who does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:1 (ESV): "There is none who does good."

questions.question: The Lord looks down from heaven on the children of man, to see if there are any who ignore?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:2 (ESV): "The Lord looks down from heaven on the children of man, to see if there are any who understand, who seek after God."

questions.question: They have all turned aside; together they have become what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:3 (ESV): "They have all turned aside; together they have become corrupt;"

questions.question: Have they no knowledge, all the evildoers who eat up my people as they eat what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:4 (ESV): "who eat up my people as they eat bread and do not call upon the Lord?"

questions.question: There they are in great terror, for God is with the generation of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:5 (ESV): "For God is with the generation of the righteous."

questions.question: You would shame the plans of the poor, but the Lord is his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:6 (ESV): "but the Lord is his refuge."

questions.question: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:7 (ESV): "Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion!"

questions.question: Who shall rejoice when the Lord restores the fortunes of his people?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:7 (ESV): "Let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad."

questions.question: Who seeks after God?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:2-3 implies God looks for any, but finding "none who does good".

questions.question: This Psalm is almost identical to which other Psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14 and Psalm 53 are very similar.

questions.question: They do not call upon whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:4 (ESV): "...and do not call upon the Lord?"

questions.question: To see if there are any who understand, who seek after whom?
They are corrupt, they do what kind of deeds?
There is none who does good, not even how many?
questions.explanation: Psalm 14:3 (ESV): "there is none who does good, not even one."

key_verse_text: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, they do abominable deeds; there is none who does good.
